featuredProjects.title: Adaptive Filter Topology Study
featuredProjects.problem: Conventional filtering approaches showed reduced resilience under dynamic interference windows.
featuredProjects.approach: Evaluated adaptive topology variants with iterative EM simulation and bench verification.
featuredProjects.outcome: Identified design approach with improved rejection behavior and stable insertion loss envelope.

featuredProjects.title: Ruggedized Microwave Module Packaging
featuredProjects.problem: Subsystem drift was observed during thermal and vibration stress combinations.
featuredProjects.approach: Ran packaging and material alternatives with stress-profile-driven test loops.
featuredProjects.outcome: Improved thermal stability and mechanical robustness in qualification simulations.

Sharma has guided Flic Microwaves from a specialized engineering firm into a trusted partner for defence, aerospace, and telecom programs. His focus on quality, accountability, and strategic growth continues to shape the company’s long-term vision.
